Application Data.NAME: Green Leaf Produce Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Leaf Produce Co. operates a retail fruit and vegetable market serving a diverse clientele, including local restaurants, schools, and catering businesses. We specialize in sourcing high-quality, fresh produce from local farms, ensuring the safety and quality of our products through strict adherence to food safety protocols and regular inspections. Our facility includes temperature-controlled storage to minimize spoilage and maintain freshness. We have implemented comprehensive inventory management practices to mitigate theft and have equipped our location with security measures, including surveillance cameras and employee training. Additionally, we provide delivery services, utilizing a managed fleet to ensure safe transportation of perishable goods to our customers.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a refrigeration compressor failure resulted in the loss of approximately $10,000 in spoiled perishable inventory. The loss has been reported to management and is currently being investigated by the maintenance team for preventive measures. The status is open, and we anticipate resolution by April 30, 2023. Additionally, there was a theft incident on June 5, 2023, where cash and inventory worth about $5,000 were stolen due to a break-in, which has been reported to local law enforcement and remains under investigation. The status of this claim is open.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras monitoring premises 24/7, installed alarm system with central station monitoring, regular staff training on loss prevention, and a dedicated employee overseeing inventory management to minimize theft and spoilage risks.
